Subject: Customer Voice Session — Scheduling & Recording Release

Hi Laura / Alex,

Hope you're both well. Thanks again for agreeing to help us capture MedPath's experience with Redwood. We'd like to schedule a short recorded conversation to shape a customer profile and pull a few anonymized quotes for a one-page highlight (no technical deep-dive required unless you want it).

High-level ask: a 30–40 minute conversation to cover outcomes, deployment highlights, and a couple of metrics you're comfortable sharing. Proposed agenda (draft):
- Introductions & goals (5m)
- Business outcomes since rollout (10m)
- How Redwood fits in your stack and ops (10m)
- Customer quote + next steps (5–10m)

Can you confirm: (a) a 30–40 minute window that works in the next week, (b) who from MedPath should join (product, engineering, or both), and (c) whether it's OK for us to record the call and use short quotes in marketing materials? If you prefer, pick a slot here: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min

I'll send an agenda and a brief release form once we lock a time.

Thanks — appreciate your time.

Best,
Olga
Olga Petrov
Senior Customer Marketing Manager

Attendees from MedPath:
- Laura Jensen — Director, Product (primary contact)
- Alex Park — CTO (technical lead)

Also: we have a standard marketing release clause in our vendor form relating to logo usage. Can you share the release you mention? An NDA is not necessary for this item.

See you on 11/30 11:00 AM PT — please send a calendar invite with the agenda and the release form.
